summary: Frontend-only end-to-end verification of the sign-out → re-login UX bug fix on the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL preview (mobile viewport 390x844). Full round-trip executed: (1) register fresh customer → lands on Book screen; (2) place an order (Downtown → Airport Terminal 1, VIP) → appears in My rides with status 'Awaiting'; (3) tap Sign out on Customer → Profile → correctly redirected to Auth / Login screen; (4) sign in as seeded admin (admin@luxedrive.com / Admin1234) → lands on Company Orders dashboard and the just-placed customer order is visible; (5) tap Sign out on Company → Profile → correctly redirected to Auth / Login screen; (6) sign in again as same customer → lands on Book screen and My rides still shows the previous order with correct pickup/dropoff. Both Profile screens correctly call `await logout()` then `router.replace('/(auth)/login')`. No red-screen or runtime errors. All 13 verification steps passed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' emitted across screens. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow.sm/md/lg usages across Profile, Book, Orders cards).

action_items: Optional: replace `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` (or wrap in Platform.select) in /app/frontend/src/theme.* to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
No functional action needed for this iteration — sign-out → re-login fix is verified working on preview.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(customer)/profile.tsx and /app/frontend/app/(company)/profile.tsx both correctly await `logout()` before calling `router.replace('/(auth)/login')`, ensuring the auth context is cleared before navigation so the auth-gated redirect in app/index.tsx does not bounce back.
auth.tsx `logout()` clears the token store before setting user to null — correct order.
Login screen `submit()` already routes company admins to /(company)/orders and customers to /(customer)/book, so re-login lands on the correct tab group.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ customer account on the fly (test_cust_<timestamp>@test.com / Pass1234) and one order via the UI. No manual DB seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logout flow is now driven by router.replace('/(auth)/login') right after await logout() in both profile.tsx files. Testing via the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL works end-to-end on mobile viewport. Playwright selectors are stable (logout-button, auth-screen, book-screen, profile-screen, request-ride-button, pickup-input, dropoff-input, email-input, password-input, auth-submit-button, login-tab, register-tab, name-input).
rca_of_issue: Previous iteration added logout buttons but only cleared auth state without navigating out of the (customer)/(company) stack, so the empty-user tabs would briefly render or users would stay on Profile. Fix added `router.replace('/(auth)/login')` after `await logout()` in both profile screens. Verified: tapping Sign out now takes the user to the Auth screen immediately in both roles, and re-logging in as a different role correctly lands on that role's home tab.
